label: fixture
title: Contrast: same workspace path 0.4.0 → 0.5.0 is not an identity conflict
notes: Control so integrators do not treat every workspace:* as unknown. resolvedOld and resolvedNew are both workspace:packages/shared-kit. Identity is the in-repo package. Then usage-bind applies: caller uses localOnly and 0.5.0 removes it ⇒ action. A newer version alone would still not be a break if the used export were unchanged.

decisionNotes: Both locators are workspace:packages/shared-kit. Same identity. c24 must not flag identity conflict.
Do not treat workspace:* itself as unknown; only workspace-vs-registry (or path mismatch) is identity conflict.
Caller statically imports localOnly; 0.5.0 removes it ⇒ action for that symbol (used + removed).
Unused added extra is not a caller defect ⇒ no_action for extra (packet rule 2).
format is used and unchanged; a newer workspace version is not itself a break (packet rule 1).
JS named-export coverage only. No full TypeScript. Nested shared-kit-core is unchanged and not the upgrade target.
